pr.body: Implemented the SPEC.md API using only the standard library. retry_budget.py validates all arguments before exhaustion checks, handles arbitrarily large attempt counts without unbounded powers, honors Retry-After without applying the backoff cap, and enforces the strict budget boundary. test_retry_budget.py adds type, range, zero, large-attempt, uncapped floor, and budget-boundary coverage. Checks passed: python -m unittest -v (9 tests), python -m compileall -q retry_budget.py test_retry_budget.py, and git diff --check. Assumption: exact built-in int validation follows the spec's exclusion of bool and float. Independent review passed with no findings.
pr.summary: Implemented deterministic retry scheduling with validated inputs, capped exponential backoff, and Retry-After handling. Before: function was a stub and all 3 basic tests errored; now: all 9 focused tests pass.
pr.title: Implement bounded retry delay scheduling

risk.why: Contained behavioral addition in retry_budget.py with focused coverage in test_retry_budget.py. The change affects retry scheduling behavior; it introduces no security, concurrency, locking, migration, or external dependency concerns.
